home.p1: I’m a full-stack developer who builds web and mobile apps <mark>end to end</mark>. I think about the interface, the API and the database together, and I take a product from idea to launch.
home.p2: I work with Next.js, React Native, Node.js and TypeScript, and I care about writing simple, fast and maintainable code.

page.p1: When I build a feature, I like to think about the screen, its API and its data model together. That’s why I don’t stay on one side of a project: I work across all of it, from the frontend to the backend and from the database to launch.
page.p2: I took my own startup, Sunflow, from idea to launch on my own. It taught me to think not only about a product’s code, but also about the people who use it and how it works day to day.
page.p3: In my free time I build small projects with microservices, message queues and new tools. I keep learning and improving.

michat.lead: A messaging app I built with a microservice architecture inside a Turborepo monorepo.

diagram.caption: Architecture
diagram.label: miChat architecture: the Next.js web app talks to an API gateway, which routes requests to the user, chat and mail services. Shared packages hold auth, cache and database code.
diagram.gateway: Single entry point for the client

goal.label: 01 · Goal
goal.p1: I wanted to build the backend and infrastructure layers end to end myself: the services, the data and how they talk to each other.
goal.p2: A messaging app is a good test for that: it needs accounts, messages and email, and each of them can run in its own service.

build.label: 02 · Structure
build.p1: Everything lives in one Turborepo monorepo, so the web app and the services share the same types and tooling.
list: The web client only talks to the API gateway.
User, chat and mail run as separate services under apps/server.
Auth, cache and database code live in shared packages, so no service copies them.
Docker Compose starts PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ locally with one command.

sections.title: Data controller
body: This site belongs to Mehmet Berk Certel. Under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), I am the data controller. You can send your questions to m.berkcertel@outlook.com.

sections.title: What I collect
body: Only what you write when you fill in the contact form: your name, email address, topic, timeline and message.
There are no accounts, ads or visitor tracking (analytics) on this site.

sections.title: Why I use it
body: I use this information only to reply to your message and to know who it is from. I don’t use it for marketing, newsletters or anything else, and I don’t share it with anyone.

sections.title: How it is kept
body: Form data is not saved in a database. Your message is sent to me as an email and stays only in my inbox for as long as our conversation needs it. If you want it deleted, just write to me.

sections.title: Service providers
body: The site is hosted on Vercel. Cloudflare Turnstile checks for spam when the form is sent, and the message is delivered through Google (Gmail). These providers may have servers outside Türkiye; the information is processed only as much as these services need to work.

sections.title: Stored in your browser
body: Your theme choice (light/dark) is stored only in your own browser. The site uses no cookies that are not needed for it to work.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Under Article 11 of KVKK, you have rights such as learning whether your data is processed and asking for it to be corrected or deleted. To do so, just write to m.berkcertel@outlook.com.
